title: Finding a Classroom
source_credit: Original WorldVoice A1 learning dialogue · text-only; no voice recording has been published.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Is this the English school?
dialogue.translation_ar: عذرًا. هل هذه مدرسة اللغة الإنجليزية؟

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Yes, it is. Are you a new student?
dialogue.translation_ar: نعم، هي كذلك. هل أنت طالب جديد؟

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Yes. My name is Lina.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Welcome, Lina. I'm Adam.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you, Adam.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you too.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: I am looking for classroom twelve.
dialogue.translation_ar: أبحث عن قاعة الدرس رقم اثني عشر.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Classroom twelve is on the second floor.
dialogue.translation_ar: قاعة الدرس رقم اثني عشر في الطابق الثاني.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Where are the stairs?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Go straight and turn left.
dialogue.translation_ar: اذهبي إلى الأمام ثم انعطفي يسارًا.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Is there an elevator?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Yes, the elevator is next to the office.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: What time does the English lesson start?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: It starts at nine thirty.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Oh, it is already nine twenty.
dialogue.translation_ar: أوه، الساعة الآن التاسعة وعشرون دقيقة.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Don't worry. You have ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Thank you for your help.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: You're welcome. Do you have a notebook?
dialogue.translation_ar: على الرحب والسعة. هل لديك دفتر؟

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Yes, I have a notebook and a pen.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Great. Have a good lesson, Lina!
dialogue.translation_ar: رائع. أتمنى لك درسًا جيدًا يا لينا!
